name: Ollipheist

attributes.attribute: wriggled through the soil of ancient Ireland
formed by water in the gully the creature cut

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Ollipheist is an Irish mythological being. This large snaky creature moved through the earth of ancient Ireland. It cut a gully, and water flowed down it to form the River Shannon. The entry directs the reader to Liscannor.

okr.objective: The Ollipheist is the creature whose gully helped form the River Shannon.
key_results: The Ollipheist is a large snaky Irish being.
It wriggled through the soil of ancient Ireland.
A gully it cut carried water that formed the River Shannon.
The entry points the reader to Liscannor.
